question: Does experience-trained selection of discriminating interventions reduce causal forecast loss versus equally budgeted random and fixed probes when passive experts may agree incorrectly, under covariate shift?
hypothesis: A native empirical action-value memory trained on separate generated worlds selects a 4-sample intervention that reduces heldout causal Brier score by >=5% versus random and fixed probes, has positive paired-bootstrap lower confidence gain versus random, and a shuffled-reward negative control is worse; it will be benchmarked against exact Bayesian entropy and exact Bayesian Brier-optimal planning.

predecessor_evidence.note: YNCA-02 exploratory negative; distinct seeds and method

inputs.name: Synthetic six-law binary intervention system, noise=0.12; observational contexts diagonal 80% training, 95% shifted evaluation
inputs.source: Generated by source-locked Python standard-library code; no external research data. Source code must be committed before heldout first-use.

seeds.development: 220001..220256 inclusive (256 worlds, may be inspected before source freeze)
seeds.heldout: 230001..230512 inclusive (512 worlds, strictly uninspected before prereg and source commit)

frozen_design.split: 6 uniformly sampled deterministic laws AND, OR, XOR, X1, X2, NOR; Bernoulli outcome flip probability 0.12. Each world 16 biased observational samples. Intervention budget exactly 4 samples at one of 4 binary action settings. Train action memory ONLY on 1024 independent worlds, no heldout tuning.
frozen_design.ordering: Commit prereg first. Commit source code and tests before first heldout. Development may be exploratory; no alteration after heldout. Posterior computed over all six laws using same 16 passive plus four intervention observations for all policies. Each policy's intervention outcomes use disjoint deterministic random streams but matched budgets.
frozen_design.data_budget: 1024 train, 256 dev, 512 heldout, 16 passive/world + 4 do samples/world/policy, 6-law finite exact inference. No protected or real source use.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python stdlib CPU only, single-pass 4x 1024 training counterfactuals and 512 heldout worlds, 1000 fixed seeded paired bootstrap draws, <=120s target runtime.
frozen_design.capacity: Native action memory key (passive evidence strength bin 3, expert disagreement bin 2, consensus flag bin 2, action 4); shrinkage 8; no learned neural foundation. Six fixed causal hypotheses are available to all Bayes baseline and candidate readout.
frozen_design.evaluator: Mean four-action heldout causal Brier score after intervention; paired bootstrap 95% mean Brier improvements over random and strongest fixed probe. Record preprobe Brier, additional 4-sample action cost, consensus-fault subgroup, wall-clock, exact source and result hashes.

controls: Exact Bayesian predictive-entropy probe (known six-law model)
Exact Bayesian expected Brier-optimal probe (known six-law model; upper reference)
metrics: Heldout mean Brier across all four interventions

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if native heldout Brier <=0.95*min(random, fixed10, fixed01), 95% paired bootstrap native-vs-random Brier gain lower bound >0, shuffled-memory Brier > native by >=0.005, and source/control/leakage audits pass. This is not official SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Native beats random or fixed but misses frozen combined threshold or independent exact Bayesian best; classify DEVELOPMENT_MIXED and do not integrate.
classification_rules.negative: Native loses to best equal-budget random/fixed baseline, or fails required superiority checks: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, preserve negative intact.
classification_rules.invalid: Data/split, source SHA, budget, leakage or baseline implementation failure: INVALID; do not reinterpret as science negative.

preregistration_note: The prereg must precede heldout execution and source commit must precede heldout execution. Synthetic contributor validation only. Exact Bayesian baselines are included, and any result cannot authorize native Yggdrasil integration.
